race.comment: TRUE FICTION (2) is hard to knock on his recent form, missing by 0.9L two back and 1.7L at his last start at Pinjarra. Paul Harvey rides now, replacing the apprentice hoop and his recent efforts stack right up. Finds the right race today and can continue his good run of recent form. PAT'S LAST BANG (10) got the job done two back before a 1.8L defeat over 1300m at Pinjarra last time out. Steve Parnham rides now and she has enough early speed to offset the tricky barrier. She rates highly on her recent form and can play a leading role. COSMIC TREAT (11) was solid first-up in what ended up being a good form race before a 2.1L defeat last time out at Pinjarra. Back to 1200m looks a good move and Chris Parnham now hops on board. She can bounce back to her best third-up. ROAMING AMERICA (5) can resume on a positive note after an impressive campaign last time in work. SLICK (9) can make an impression on her return.
